title: Quartic signed-genback direct composition
objective: Compose the authentic quartic signed genback output directly into quartic nf_cxlog and class assembly in one ordinary-Python public root, with no PARI or intermediate answer fixtures at runtime

handoff.summary: Adds one ordinary-Python public root that derives the authentic Smith columns for x^4-200000002*x-200000002, performs all seven computed T2/LLL signed-genback reductions, constructs both G ideals and seven Ge factors, and immediately consumes them through mixed-quartic nf_cxlog/class assembly. Pristine PARI 2.17.4, CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged outputs agree exactly, and a corrupted-prime control leaves every publication owner unchanged.
risks: The root deliberately supports only the authenticated dimension-3, two-generator Smith shape and is correctness evidence, not a qualified timing result.
Prepared embeddings, relation HNF/logs, factor-base prime ideals, multiplication table, and rounded T2 remain explicit upstream inputs.
Windows uses the tested dynamic fallback until the full native dependency graph is qualified there.
The broad portable suite was attempted but stopped immediately because an interrupted concurrent build left dist/runtime-cache absent; the focused checker and architecture audit pass.
next_steps: Integrate this root into the durable replay graph without weakening the existing fixture hashes.
Generalize the signed-genback schedule from the authenticated Uir columns before accepting arbitrary quartic fields.
Compose relation collection and prepared-field construction upstream of this boundary.
